<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 160.80, 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm, giving seven distinct aromatic carbon environments. Hence the molecule contains 7 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
